plain: Extremely bad and deserving to be cursed.

webster.text: Deserving to be cursed; very hateful; detestable; abominable; as an execrable wretch.

example.quote: A standing army we shall have, also, to execute the execrable commands of tyranny ; and how are you to punish them ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 5, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
